starts tune A: twelve bytes of the tune table from $1118 (speed, transpose and each voice's sequence list), the SID silenced ($0D01), the filter's resonance and cutoff, every voice's variables cleared, the NMI vector pointed at the sample player ($0938) and CIA 2's timer A allowed to raise it

the sample player, run on each NMI from CIA 2's timer A: writes one 4-bit step of the sound to the SID's volume ($D418, plus $34 for the filter's mode), the high and the low half of each byte in turn ($FF counts the halves); at the byte $1F it stops; the timer's speed sets the pitch

the sample channel: reads the next entry of its sequence (through $111A by the pattern in $F2, the pattern list from $110F): an instrument ($C0 and up: the sample's start, end and settings from the table at $126A, five bytes each), a length ($80-$BF), or a note, whose rate it sets on CIA 2's timer A from the table at $10CD; the timer then starts
the operand of the ADC at $0ACF, rewritten as the game runs, by $0AC9
bytes after sample_sequence's RTS that no path reaches, $0B43-$0B5E

reads a voice's next commands: $FF loops the pattern, the pattern list's entries (transpose, repeats); $FD a slide, $E0-$FF a rest, $C0-$DF an instrument, $80-$BF a length, $60-$7F an arpeggio, and a note below $60; sets the voice's instrument up from the table at $11CE (8 bytes each)
